characters.name: In General
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Each of the Ninja have animal symbols that reflect their personalities and elemental powers. See their character folders below. Arc Words: "Ninja never quit." Badass Adorable: The Ninja have their quirky and endearing traits, but can still kick butt when the time calls for it. Berserk Button:In "Double Trouble", when Jay found out his evil double kissed Nya.Anything to do with Nya in trouble for both Jay and Kai.Never, NEVER ask Nya out on a date within earshot of Jay or Kai, or both.A threat to cake or somewhat his father for Cole.His friends being in danger for Zane, which unlocks his True Potential.'"You will not hurt my friends!"If you hurt one of the Ninja badly or attempt to kill them, the others will react badly and hold a grudge.Nya, between Jay and Cole, throughout most of Season 3 and the first three episodes of Season 4.Lloyd,regarding Garmadon sacrificing himself, and in turn, leaving him foreverin "The Corridor of Elders." In "Double Trouble", when Jay found out his evil double kissed Nya.

characters.name: Lloyd
characters.description: The son of Garmadon and Misako, nephew of Sensei Wu, and grandson of the First Spinjitzu Master. Once a bratty kid who sought to follow in his father's villainous footsteps, Lloyd changed his ways, helping the Ninja and realizing his destiny was to become the Green Ninja. As the Ninja trained Lloyd, he reunited with Misako and faced Garmadon and the Overlord. During his long, difficult journey, Lloyd has grown from a young, childish prankster to a strong, wise, and capable leader. Adorably Precocious Child: And still pretty cute when he gets older, too, albeit in adifferent way. All of the Other Reindeer: Lloyd mentions that he hates the time he spent at Darkley's Boarding School for Bad Boys, heavily implying that he was frequently bullied there. TheLloyd Garmadon's Blog at LEGOClub.comconfirms that he was indeed theButt-Monkeyof the school. All Your Powers Combined: As the Green Ninja, he can use the four main Elements of Creation — Earth, Fire, Ice, and Lightning. He later loses this ability when The Overlord steals most of his Golden Power and he shares the rest of it with the other four Ninja, leaving him with just the Elemental Power of Life. Animal Motifs: Dragons, which represent his energy element and part of his lineage.

characters.name: Cole
characters.description: Cole was originally sent to the Marty Oppenheimer School of Performing Arts by his father, who hoped that he would follow in his footsteps and become a dancer. Unwilling to do so but reluctant to displease his father, Cole secretly ran away from the school. He first met Master Wu while climbing the highest mountain in Ninjago as a test of strength. Learning that he had great potential, he followed the old master to the Monastery and began training to become a ninja alongside Jay and Zane. With the addition of Kai to the team, Master Wu sent the Four Ninja on a quest to defeat the plans of his evil brother and to find the Golden Weapons of Spinjitzu. Ambiguously Bi: He had brief romance with Nya in Season 3, though he was just playing along according toWord of God, he seemed to have no problem reciprocating Nya's attraction, and he has some lightShip Teasewith Vania. Then there's his relationship with Geo, which isfarmore affectionate than any of Cole's other friendships or whatever he had with Nya and Vania. Ambiguously Brown: Cole's humanoid design inFortnitegives himdark skin, despite him having the same classic LEGO yellow as everyone else in minifigure form. Animal Motifs: Gorillas, which represent his earth element andSuper-Strength. Badass Biker: In season 5, Cole has aCool Bikebuilt by Cyrus Borg to take down Morro's army of ghosts. In Season 11, he gets anotherCool Bikecourtesy of P.I.X.A.L. seems the Borgs really like giving Cole motorcycles to ride.

characters.name: Jay
characters.description: Amnesiac Resonance:Season 2 of "Dragons Rising" reveals he lost his memory after the Merge, but despite that he still acts pretty much like he always does, preferring to slack off and play video games rather than work. He also has subtle feelings for Nya, even going back to her after initially trying to abandon the Ninja against Thunderfang because being with her made him feel better about himself. Animal Motifs: Octopuses, which represent his lightning element and active nature. Atrocious Alias: In order to infiltrate the Land of Lee, he dubs himself "McCoolGuy". Oh, sorry,CountMcCoolGuy. Even Wyldfyre, no stranger to terrible disguises, thinks it's pretty stupid. Battle Couple: With Nya. They combined their elemental powers to create thefirst Fusion Dragonseen in the show, and figured out how to fight the Vermillion together. Beware the Silly Ones: He’s the most lighthearted and humorous of the team, but he’s still a skilled ninja and a powerful Elemental Master.Dragons Risingshows what he could be like when he’s serious, and he's shown to be even more ruthless than all the Ninja combined!

characters.name: Kai
characters.description: Absurd Phobia:When one of the Venomari spitted venom on his eyes that caused a distorted vision, Kai apparently has a fear of Christmas-related subjects such as elves and gingerbread men.He gains a sudden fear of water in Season 5, being extremely hesitant to swim in or go anywhere near it. This never gets brought up again in any of the subsequent seasons. When one of the Venomari spitted venom on his eyes that caused a distorted vision, Kai apparently has a fear of Christmas-related subjects such as elves and gingerbread men. He gains a sudden fear of water in Season 5, being extremely hesitant to swim in or go anywhere near it. This never gets brought up again in any of the subsequent seasons. Acquired Situational Narcissism: As a result of the Ninja achieving celebrity status by Season 6, the fame goes to Kai's head and causes him to develop a bigger ego. He indulges his fangirls by constantly flirting with them, enjoys merchandise styled after his image, and is addicted to using Chirp (the in-universe version of Twitter). All Your Powers Combined: Very briefly gains hold of the Elemental Staff in Season 4, thus gaining hold of every element stored within it.

characters.name: Zane
characters.description: The Ageless: He is unable to physically age due to being a robot, which causes him to outlive his creator. He's implied to be the oldest out of the Ninja (around 40 years old at most) but still looks like a vaguely-aged teenager. Anguished Declaration of Love: When Lloyd finds his recording in the Never-Realm, Zane states that [he loves Pixal before the recording cuts out. Animal Motifs: Tigers, which represent his ice element and intelligence. Art Evolution: Other than his post-timeskip appearance in Season 8, his titanium body was rendered matte in Season 7 while it was shiny from Seasons 4-6. Badass Bookworm: He reads the most out of the four main ninja.

characters.name: Nya
characters.description: The Ace: Out of all the Ninja, Nya is this. She's a genius and capable fighter who is good at everything she tries long before she found out she was the water ninja. Though it's later deconstructed when training to be a ninja as her natural talent at most things means that when she comes across something that doesn't come naturally to her, she will give up rather than try harder. Action Girl: She displays a willingness to fight as early as the pilot episode, in which she fights alongside Kai to ward off the Skullkin.Nya: Age is just a state of mind in my opinion. I am old enough to drive and kick some bad guy butt. All Girls Want Bad Boys: In one episode, Nya gets very excited when Jay gets briefly replaced by hisEvil Twin. Although, aside from that, she loves Jay and hisadorkableself,Warts and All. Animal Motifs: Phoenixes, which ironically represent her water element andDeterminatorpersonality. Ascend to a Higher Plane of Existence: At the end of Season 14Nya becomes one with the ocean itself.She gets better in the next season.

characters.name: Sensei Wu
characters.description: Having accumulated much experience and wisdom over the last forty years, he would later seek out the Ninja and become their mentor in order to help them against their foes. After slowly aging to death, the Ninja were forced to use the time reversal blade on him to save his life. Although they succeeded, Wu was accidentally turned into a toddler because of this, and the Sons of Garmadon kidnap him and Misako in order to use him to get the last Oni Mask. Over time, he gradually ages back to normal, reclaims his father's armor, and confronts Garmadon alongside Lloyd. Advertised Extra: Despite being in the opening credits for season 4, he doesn't really play a part until the final few episodes. Garmadon is mostly the main mentor for the ninja in that season. The Ageless: Not obvious at first, but it eventually turns out he's at least a thousand years old. You wouldn't know it from looking at him. Arch-Enemy: His is Aspheera, a Serpentine that Wu taught Spinjitzu to, that double crossed him and used him to take over the Serpentine.

characters.name: The Guardians of the Golden Weapons
characters.description: All Animals Are Dogs: They're dragons whom the ninja treat as their pets, particularly Rocky with Cole. Anti-Hero: They started off as this. They're supposed to protect the golden weapons from evil but they won't hesitant to attack other heroic characters like the ninja. Fortunately, they become full "heroes" once the ninja domesticate them. Elemental Powers: All four dragons have powers based on the respective weapon they're supposed to protect.Rocky, guardian of the Scythe of Quakes, is associated withEarth.Shard, guardian of the Shurikens of Ice, is associated withIce.Wisp, guardian of the Nunchucks of Lightning, is associated withLightning.Flame, guardian of the Sword of Fire, is associated withFire. Rocky, guardian of the Scythe of Quakes, is associated withEarth. Shard, guardian of the Shurikens of Ice, is associated withIce.

characters.name: Garmadon
characters.description: His villainy culminated in him being unwillingly possessed by the Overlord. In a final fight with Lloyd, the Overlord was defeated and exorcised from Garmadon along with all the evil in his blood, leaving him a normal human being again. Garmadon then takes up mentorship as penance for his evil, trying to and eventually failing to take a pacifist path. Catching his son trying to sneak off to a tournament with the Ninja, Garmadon joined them, knowing their host only too well as his evil former sensei, Master Chen. Garmadon did his best to protect Lloyd during the tournament, and finally sacrificed himself to stop a second Serpentine War. Season 8 has him brought back from the Cursed Realm by his worshipers, The Sons Of Garmadon. Unlike before, Garmadon was brought back with only the worst traits of himself, making him completely different from even his former evil self. However, despite temporarily winning, even this Garmadon couldn't truly bring himself to kill Lloyd and after being defeated in Season 9 and then helping stop the threat of the Oni in Season 10 he went on a journey of self-reflection to not only comprehend who he was but also work towards becoming someone who'd one day make amends with his family and rejoin them. 0% Approval Rating: By Seasons 10 and 15, this is how he ends upbecause he can't commit to either being a destroyer or a good guy and ends up hurting countless people with his actions. No side wants him around besides a few individuals; the people of Ninjago hate him for the tyrannical reign he led and the suffering he put them through, the Ninjas distrust and reject his advice at all turns for trying to kill them, the Sons of Garmadon turn on him for helping the Ninja, Harumi herself drops any admiration towards him after he unwittingly caused her death and even Lloyd shows resentment towards him for his past actions. The few people to do more than just tolerate him are Wu, who shows care and respect towards Garmadon due to being his brother

characters.name: Ed and Edna Walker
characters.description: Jay's very eccentric, yet loving parents. Amazingly Embarrassing Parents: At first, including commenting on Nya right in front of Jay, or telling all his friends about Jay's potty training. Badass Driver: They prove to be this in "Ninjaball Run." Body Horror: Get bitten by the Fangpires and not only affects them but their creations. Cloudcuckoolander: They're nice, but definitely very strange, and it's easy to see why Jay has turned out the way he has.

characters.name: Mystake
characters.description: An elderly lady that owns a tea shop in Ninjago. She has knowledge of all sorts of brews, including the dimension-hopping Traveler's Tea. In Season 9, it is revealed she is an Oni. Ascended Extra: In Seasons 1 and 2, she primarily serves as a means to establish Travelers Tea and intermittently helps the heroes. In Season 8 she establishes the existence of the Oni as well as the stakes of Lord Garmadon's resurrection, and in the following season becomes a member of Lloyd's resistance against the Sons of Garmadon. Big Good: Substitutes for Master Wu in this role during "Hunted", becoming Lloyd's mentor as he tries to lead the resistance. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: Acts very nutty at times, but she does definitely know her stuff. Catchphrase: "Never heard of it".

characters.name: Lou
characters.description: Cole's father, a singer with the Royal Blacksmiths. Amazon Chaser: Implied, given what's been revealed about his wife and Cole's mother in Season 13. Distressed Dude: He and the Royal Blacksmiths are abducted off-screen by the Vermillion Warriors, who mistakenly assumed the name meant they were actual blacksmiths. Freudian Excuse: Part of his stern attitude was due to mourning his wife's death, which he never fully got over. Good Parents: While he is a bit harsh on Cole when introduced, he eventually accepts that his son is a ninja and not a dancer.

characters.name: Dareth, the "Brown Ninja"
characters.description: A cocky kung-fu "Sensei" who allows the Ninja to train Lloyd at his Dojo, entitled "Dareth's Mojo Dojo." He is revealed to have lied about his kung-fu claims. Achievements in Ignorance:He inadvertently acquired control of the Overlord's stone army after putting on the Helmet of Shadows, thinking it was just a regular helmet. Ascended Extra: He's largely an ally who frequently gets himself into trouble, but is a part of Lloyd's resistance in Season 9. Blessed with Suck: Mystake grants him powers that seems to be inducingPotty Emergencyinhimself. Character Development: In his early appearances he's largely a cowardly braggart. In later appearances, he becomes much more courageous and willing to try and help the ninja.

characters.name: Dr. Julien
characters.description: Zane's father, or rather, his creator. All There in the Manual: His name has never been revealed in the show until season 11, but is mentioned in the LEGO Ninjago Character Encyclopedia. Back from the Dead:In "The Last Voyage", the Ninja find him on a prison tower in the middle of the ocean and learn that on his deathbed, he was revived by Samukai so he could design vehicles for the Skeleton Army. It only kept him alive for a little while longer, as he was still frail and weak, and he passed away in theTime Skipbetween seasons 2 and 3. Gadgeteer Genius: His achievements includeZane, the Falcon, and a guardian robot, all of which he built from a small workshop in the Birchwood Forest.Later, after being brought back from the dead, he helps design the vehicles for the Skeleton Army. After he is rescued he builds a Power Driller for Cole. Gratuitous German: "I thought I waskaput."

characters.name: Misako
characters.description: Lloyd Garmadon's mother and Garmadon's wife. Absurdly Elderly Mother: Although Lloyd is chronologically a young kid (who has gone through some artificial aging) she seems pretty old for a mother. Action Mom: She can fight as well as she can teach.She manages to walk away from a fight with the resurrected Garmadon, who'd just pulverised Lloyd, with only assistance from Nya. Berserk Button:DON'Timply she's old. Wu learned this the hard way. Daddy Had a Good Reason for Abandoning You: So she claims, though Lloyd is still (and understandably) hurt by it.

characters.name: P.I.X.A.L./The 2nd Samurai X
characters.description: A Nindroid created to be Borg's assistant, before becoming the Ninja's ally. A.I.-cronym: Her name stands for Primary Interactive X-Ternal Assistant Life-form. She actually asks Zane what his name stands for, thinking it's also an acronym. Ascended Extra: She started off as just "Zane's Girlfriend" and more or less became apart of the core cast as of season 8. Barbie Doll Anatomy: Doesn't have any breasts to speak of whatsoever, which is good, because she typically hasa lotof her chest exposed. Subverted later on when she becomes Samurai X, as there are notable breast lines on her chest now. Battle Couple: With Zane after he gives her half of his power core. Together, they can use Spinjitzu. After he rebuilds himself at the end of Season 3 and Pixal becomes the second Samurai X, they continue to be this without needing co-dependence for Spinjitzu.

characters.name: Cyrus Borg
characters.description: The head of Borg Industries and the creator of P.I.X.A.L. He is a brilliant scientist who helped rebuild Ninjago City into the technologically advanced New Ninjago City. Artificial Limbs: Post-cybernetic transformation, his right arm has become robotic. Brainwashed and Crazy: The Overlord takes control of him after he gives the Ninja the Techno-Blades. Cool Chair: He was disabled from birth, so he built his moving chair. Although he sadly loses it thanks to the Overlord. Cybernetics Eat Your Soul: Happens to the poor mantwice. First forcefully roboticized to let the Overlord use his walker as a physical avatar. After he was freed, he was kidnapped later on and roboticized yet again thanks toPythor helping Overlord.

characters.name: Ronin
characters.description: Ronin is a selfish yet skilled thief and bounty hunter, whose deal with the Soul Archer caused him to become involved in the Ninja's conflict with Morro and the Ghost Army. Initially siding with whoever he thought would save his skin, Ronin eventually returned, fully committed, to help fight the Ghost Army alongside the Ninja at the Battle of Stiix. Ronin returned later on, as more of a neutral party. Adaptational Heroism: In Shadows of Ronin, he's a full-on villain who worked for Chen. In the series, while he isn't certainly the nicest guy, he's more of anAnti-Herowhose villainous actions are rare and typically only for money. Anti-Hero: At first glance, Ronin is a selfish yet skilled thief and bounty hunter. He often took terrible actions, making deals with the evil Soul Archer and selling Zane to Master Chen. However,looking to change his ways, Ronin sided with the Ninja and oversaw Nya as she tried to master her water element. This proves that he has an sympathetic backstory, as his motivation for in the game was actually to save his cursed soul. Eventually, his more sincere personality comes through in the episode, "Curse World: Part 1," when he arrives in his airship R.E.X. and promptly dumps every amount of money he ever made on the building Morro had lifted with his elemental wind power, giving Lloyd the chance to defeat Morro. From that point on he is the Ninjas' friend and ally... aside from helping arrest them all in season 6.His villainous side finally takes prominence in-canon) inThe Island, having tricked the Keepers with an animatronic Wojira so they would send all their valuables to it for offerings, which he could then turn a profit off of. His villainous side finally takes prominence in-canon) inThe Island, having tricked the Keepers with an animatronic Wojira so they would send all their valuables to it for offerings, which he could then turn a profit off of. Badass Normal: Despite lacking the elemental or magical powers that most of the other cha

characters.name: Nelson, the "Purple Ninja"
characters.description: A kid who broke both of his legs training to become a ninja and was later visited in the hospital by the Ninja and made the honorary "Purple Ninja." His appearance from Season 11 onwards has him become older and is now working as a paperboy. Ascended Extra: He appears only once in Season 6, but becomes a recurring character in Seasons 11-15, with multiplefocus episodesaround him. A Day in the Limelight: In "The News Never Sleeps!" in Season 11 and "Papergirl" in Season 14 alongside Antonia. I Got Bigger: Season 11 has him appear considerably older than he was in Season 6. Iron Butt-Monkey: If his various pictures of him injured are any indication, he was very prone to injury up until "The News Never Sleeps!". In said episode, he's completely surprised he made a jump over a broken bridge without getting hurt.

characters.name: The Commissioner
characters.description: The current head of the Ninjago City police department. Defiant to the End: It'shisduty to protect Ninjago City, and the Ninja arehisallies, and he will stand by it even when cornered by someone likeNadakhanorKalmaar. Eye Twitch: Happens when he gets angry. Inspector Javert: When the ninja get framed, he becomes hell-bent on arresting them all. No Name Given: His name is never given, being simply known as "The Commissioner".

characters.name: Echo Zane
characters.description: The prototype of Zane found in the basement of Dr. Julien's lab. Easily Detachable Robot Parts: Notintentionally, mind. His disrepaired state means his arms and legs will fall off at a moment's notice, usually at the worst time. Guest-Star Party Member: Jay recruits him for the team in the final fight of season 6. Replacement Goldfish: Jay and Nya figure Dr. Julien made him as a replacement for Zane. Smart People Play Chess: Or try to, but he goes up against an enemy who cheats, and never figures it out.

characters.name: Ray and Maya
characters.description: Kai and Nya's parents, and the original Elemental Masters of Fire and Water. Action Dad: While it takes a while for him compared to Maya, Ray assists the Ninja when they go and look forthe Storm Amule that Clutch Powers stole from the Keeperst. He also takes part in the brawl to stop King Kalmaar's attack on Ninjago City to gain the artifact. Action Mom: Maya proves that while she may have lost her powers, she's still a former Elemental MasterandNinja. Joining her daughter in investigating the Tartarus Trench and helping them fight off Merlopians. The Bus Came Back: After Season 7 they seemingly disappear, only returning in Season 14: "Seabound". Daddy Had a Good Reason for Abandoning You:They were forced to forge armor for the Vermillion Warriors under the threat that Krux would harm Kai and Nya if they refused. This left them absent from their children's lives for many years.

characters.name: The Emperor and Empress of Ninjago
characters.description: The rulers of Ninjago, and Harumi's adopted parents. Authority in Name Only: In spite of their pompous titles, they have no role in Ninjago's political affairs, being mere figureheads. The Emperor: As the title suggests, they are the rulers of Ninjago, but they are abenevolentexample of this trope. Killed Offscreen: They were killed during the Temple's destruction. No Good Deed Goes Unpunished: They adopted a child who was orphaned by the Great Devourer to raise as their own.Unfortunately,their well-intentioned but strict parenting made her resent them, to the point that she willingly had them killed.

characters.name: Hutchins
characters.description: The Master-at-Arms for the Royal Family. Cool Helmet: Wears a samurai helmet that is covered completely in gold. Fan Boy: Turns out to have a Kai action figure in his pocket. Killed Offscreen: He perishes alongside the Emperor and Empress during the attack at the Royal palace. Red Herring: At first, he appears to be in kahoots with the Sons of Garmadon. It turns out he isn't.

characters.name: Antonia
characters.description: The leader of the paperboys. She shows Nelson the ropes and pratfalls of the job while teaching him tricks to avoid the dangers that assault Ninjago City on a regular basis. Badass Normal: She may not be a ninja, but she's capable of performing impressive stunts with her bike to avoid danger, and its implied all the Paperboys are somewhat just as skilled if it means getting the news to the people of Ninjago. She even manages to earnVillain Respectfrom Kalmaar in "Papergirl" as she and Nelson give him a tough chase to get the Storm Amulet back from them before he catches them, saying that she's the only one that ever came close to stopping him. A Day in the Limelight: In "Papergirl". Platonic Life-Partners: She and Nelson are very close with each other, they work together and even attend dancing lessons together, but they don't appear to be anything more than best friends. Strolling Through the Chaos: Both she and the paperboys are incredibly used to the occasional dangers that happen in Ninjago, to the point that Aspheera's attack on Ninjago City is just another day of spreading the news to the citizens to them.

characters.name: Sorla
characters.description: The elderly leader of the Ice Fishers, a village of humans living near the Great Leak in the Never-Realm.—- Cool Old Lady: Pun aside. She's a wise, warm, and welcoming old woman, who gives Kai advice that helps himsregain his powers.She also helps train Nyain being able to control ice after she finds herself frustrated that she isn't much help in the Never-Realm. Early-Bird Cameo: Somehow, Zane was able to disguise as her back in "The Explorers Club". Human Popsicle:She and her village attempt to flee the Ice Emperor's dragon: Boreal, but unfortunately don't get very far and are frozen solid. Thankfully they get better. Suspiciously Similar Substitute: She's very similar to Mystake, both being elderly wise women that share their wisdom and mentor the Ninja.

characters.name: Akita
characters.description: A girl that is the last of the Formlings, a race of shapeshifters in the Never-Realm. She is able to turn into a wolf. She seeks revenge on the Ice Emperor for freezing the rest of her kind and teams up with Lloyd to do so. She returns in the sequel series, “Dragons Rising”, in the second half of Season 4 as one of the heads of the Council of the Merged Lands. Animal Motifs: Wolves, being the form she turns into. Asian Fox Spirit: While her animal form is a wolf, it's appereance evokes a kitsune especially with it's colors and three tails. Deadpan Snarker: Manages to be this in both human and wolf forms, mostly when Lloyd talks about Harumi. Force and Finesse: The finesse to her brothers' force, her wolf form being more agile than her brother's stronger bear form.

characters.name: Kataru
characters.description: Akita's brother, and a prisoner in the Ice Emperor's dungeon. Animal Motifs: Bears. Besides turning into one, he's nearly always hungry and would prefer to sleep for half a year. Distressed Dude: Is a prisoner in the Ice Emperor's dungeon. Force and Finesse: The force to his sisters finesse, her wolf form being more agile than his stronger bear form. Magic Pants: Whenever he transforms into a bear, her clothes disappear. Whenever he tranforms back, said clothes reappear unscathed.

characters.name: Krag
characters.description: A yeti who watches over the Traveller's Tree in the Never-Realm. Gentle Giant: Despite his intimidating appearance, he's quite friendly to everyone that travels to the Traveller's Tree. Last of His Kind:You can thank Vex and the Ice Emperor for that. And the other yetidon'tget better.

characters.name: League of Jay
characters.description: A group of Prime Empire players who style themselves after Jay. They help Scott stay hidden from Unagami in exchange for him fixing their vehicles and weapons. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: They may be eccentric, but they know a lot of tricks and how to hold their own in a fight. Cloudcuckoolander: They're definitely quirky to say the least. Continuity Nod: Their avatars all consist of the different gi he has worn from the previous seasons, some even sporting his classic design.

characters.name: Scott
characters.description: A mysterious Prime Empire player living in a hidden corner of the game while hiding from Unagami, remaining so using an undetectable barrier and with the help of the League of Jay.He's revealed to be a former video game tester for Milton Dyer's company and the first person to play Prime Empire, becoming trapped inside the game after Unagami heard him say he wanted a bigger challenge and invited him in. And I Must Scream:He's been trapped inside Prime Empire fordecades. The fact that he has only one life left means he can't afford to take any risks that would cause him to lose it, which doesn't help his situation either. Be Careful What You Wish For:He originally entered the Prime Empire game because he wanted a challenge. Unfortunately Milton and the producers shut down the game after he entered it and since Unagami didn't tell anyone where Scott was, he ended up trapped alone for thirty years. Heroic Sacrifice:Gets cubed by Red Visors trying to help the ninja escape when his hideout is discovered. He gets better. Knight in Sour Armor:Having been trapped in Prime Empire for a very long time, Scott becomes overly cautious and bitter, as he chooses to remain on the sidelines due to having only one life remaining before he'd be "cubed". However, after spending time with the Ninja, he chooses to become more of a hero, giving his life to helping the Ninja evade the Red Visors.

characters.name: Okino
characters.description: A Prime Empire NPC who resides in Terra Karana, a samurai helping to guide players though various dangers to obtain the Keytana hidden in the Maze of the Red Dragon. Break the Badass: Losing so many masters really took a toll on his confidence until the ninja came along. The Bus Came Back:He makes cameos in Seasons 14 and 15. Despair Event Horizon: He is left disheartened and depressed after losing so many masters. It gets worse for him when he find out his world is a videogame, leaving him absolutely devastated, but the Ninja help him get better. Earn Your Happy Ending: After failing all of his masters andsacrificing his chance to leavePrime Empire, he succeeds in bothguiding the ninja through the maze safe and sound and visiting the real world.

characters.name: Racer Seven / Blazey H. Speed
characters.description: A Prime Empire NPC who competes in the Speedway Five Billion, trying and failing to win at least once without crashing. After making a life for herself in the real world, she would officially go by the name Blazey H. Speed. Drives Like Crazy: When she isn't driving on the racetrack, turns out she does this, even with something like a news van. Though considering the urgency of getting Cole and Vinny to the NGTV News Tower, it was rather necessary. Yank the Dog's Chain: Her whole existence is this. Whenever Racer Seven is racing and it looks like she will win, her programming will kick in and she willalwayswipe out and someone else wins instead.She finally wins a race thanks to some motivational words from the ninja to overcome her programming.

characters.name: Milton Dyer
characters.description: The elusive and enigmatic creator of Prime Empire. The Atoner:After he realizes he drove Unagami to grief-induced madness, he's quick to try to make amends. Just a Machine:He initially doesn't show much regret for shutting down Unagami, and is surprised at P.I.X.A.L. seemingly being able to emulate feelings rather thanactuallyfeel. Once he realizes that P.I.X.A.L. and Zane's emotions are real, he recognizes that he made a mistake shutting down Unagami, and genuinely apologizes for not understanding he had feelings. The two reconcile with Unagami becoming Milton's son. Red Herring: The Ninjas spend most ofPrime Empirethinking that he's Unagami, with there being quite a bit of evidence directing toward that possibility.The final act reveals he was the one who ultimately first shut him down, and ends up an ally to the Ninja. Walking Spoiler: Is the creator of Prime Empire andUnagami, akaUnfinishedAdventureGame1.

characters.name: Princess Vania
characters.description: The princess and eventually queen of Shintaro. Action Girl: After Cole and the Ninja have been gone for a long time while underground. She finally decides to step up and help, bringing along her pet dragon Chompy. Abusive Parents: Her father King Vangelis tends to be rather emotionally controlling towards her.Then it reaches a whole new level when he reveals himself to be the Skull Sorcerer. Archnemesis Dad:Her father turns out to be the Skull Sorcerer. The Dog Bites Back:When her father tries toplay the family carddespite previously disowning her as his daughter, Vania refuses to hear his excuses and orders him locked up.

characters.name: Chompy
characters.description: Shoulder-Sized Dragon: It's regular form is about the size of a house cat, and can easily climb atop their master and other characters without much issue. Sizeshifter: Is capable of growing from a small size to a size as big as previously seen dragons.

characters.name: Munce
characters.description: Adaptational Villainy: In the sets they are portrayed as enemies, yet in the show they are allies to the Ninja. All Trolls Are Different: They are pretty much a mish-mash between trolls and orcs. Barbaric Battle Axe: To complement their Orc-like appearance and culture, many of them carry around axes or pole axes. Proud Warrior Race: As revealed by "Queen of the Munce", they are a very hardy Orc-ish race. Murtessa puts it succintly in "Grief-Bringer".Murtessa:Munce are proud, strong! They respect only power! Verbal Tic: They always pronounce people's names starting with "M", such as "Cole" being pronounced as "Mole", or "Lilly" as "Milly."

characters.name: Geckles
characters.description: Adaptational Villainy: Like the Munce, the Geckle in the sets are presented as enemies but are allies in the show. Granted they did send Kai and Zane to a trial by Mino to see if they are with the Skull Sorcerer's Re-Awakened or not. Our Goblins Are Different: They are a race of purple-skinned goblin-like beings that live underground and are for the most part friendly if a bit paranoid and a little dim. They also have a strangely democratic and bureaucratic system where they are lead by a chancellor and choose their leader or express their approval, by voting through throwing pebbles at someone. Trial by Ordeal: One of their ways of settling things is Trial by Mino, which is sicking a giant rocky rhino on some unlucky saps. Verbal Tic: They always pronounce people's names starting with "G", such as "Lilly" as "Gilly." A Geckle who wears a locket given to him by Lilly.

characters.name: The Lowly/Upply (Korgran, Fungus, Plundar, and Adam)
characters.description: A team of adventurers hired by King Vangelis years ago to investigate the dungeons of Shintaro and retrieve the Skull of Hazza D'ur, only for them to be betrayed and cast deep beneath the mountain. They join forces with Cole and the other ninja to help take down the Skull Sorcerer. Their team consists of Korgran the warrior, Fungus the sorcerer, Plundar the thief, and Adam the giant spider. Aerith and Bob: Ironically, of the four adventurers the one with the most ordinary name is Adam theGiant Spider. Ambiguous Situation: Does Korgran's axe really talk to him, or is it just in his imagination? "The Ascent" seems to finally answer that itdoestalk, as it calls Cole and the others bananas and they presumably heard it. Amplified Animal Aptitude: Adam is surprisingly quite sentient and smart. One notable moment has him pulling a lever to close a trapdoor that the Awakened skeletons opened, without the input of neither Plundar nor Cole. Barbaric Battle Axe: Fitting his image as aBarbarian Hero, Korgran carries a massive double-bladed battle axe that may or may not talk to him.

characters.name: Timothy "Twitchy Tim" Batterson
characters.description: An explorer who was stranded on the Island of the Keepers years ago when his hot air balloon was blown off course into the Storm Belt. He managed to escape the island, although repeated lightning strikes left him with a case of retrograde amnesia. He is asked by the ninja to help them get through the Storm Belt to rescue Master Wu, Misako, and Clutch Powers from the Island of the Keepers. The Bus Came Back: Makes a cameo during the last episode of Season 14 and appears in Season 15. Cowardly Lion: He would rather hide than try to brave the dangers he faced on the island again. He faces his fears thanks to some inspiring words from Lloyd andgoes on to save the ninja when they're in trouble. Forgetful Jones: Getting struck by lightning multiple times left him with retrograde amnesia. In-Series Nickname: His name is Timothy Batterson, but everyone calls him "Twitchy Tim" or just "Twitchy."

characters.name: Zippy
characters.description: A hyperactive dragon living on the Island of the Keepers who befriends the ninja. All Animals Are Dogs: He behaves very much like an energetic dog. With the Ninja almost constantly having to play fetch with it to keep it occupied. Back for the Finale: Appears in "Crystalized" being ridden into battle by Benthomaar as they battle the Crystal King's Army. Expy: Appears to be based off ofScooby-Doo.

characters.name: King Trimaar
characters.description: The former king of Merlopia, the father of Kalmaar, and the adoptive father of Benthomaar. He is fatally injured by Kalmaar trying to stop his son from awakening Wojira. Died in Your Arms Tonight:Dies in the arms of Benthomaar, telling his son to assist the ninja and stop Kalmaar. The Good King: Unlike Kalmaar, Trimaar did not hold a grudge against the surface dwellers and only sought to retain peace. Horrible Judge of Character: He never seemed to notice Kalmaar was a real piece of work from childhood.It gets him killed. Killed Off for Real:Courtesy of Kalmaar. He's also one of few characters in the series to die onscreen.

characters.name: Prince Benthomaar
characters.description: The adopted son of King Trimaar and the adoptive brother of Kalmaar. He assists the ninja with stopping Kalmaar afterthe latter kills King Trimaar. Back for the Finale: Alongside many other characters, he appears in the final season "Crystalized" bringing along the Keepers with him, and even riding Zippy into battle. Boom Stick: Mixed withShock Stick, his spear has a similar ability to other Merlopian tridents, being able to shoot bolts of electricity. Contrasting Replacement Character:Benthomaar is both similar and different to Princess Vania from the previous season. Both are children of royalty, although Benthomaar was adopted, both became useful allies to the Ninja, rebel against their kingdoms and their respective rulers, and the current rulers of their kingdoms are horrible people who are also their relatives. For him it was his brother Kalmaar, but for Vania it washer own father King Vangelis.Bentho and Vania also share a moment where they try to convince their respective kingdom's armies that their leader is lying to them.While Vania was successfull and pulls aBig Damn Heroesmoment with her kingdom's army, Benthomaar is not so lucky and continues fighting them until King Kalmaar is finally dead.He is another contrast to Harumi alongside Princess Vania. Similarly to Harumi he was adopted into royalty,but unlike Harumi never grew to hate their adoptive parent(s)and is a genuine ally to the Ninja. In fact it's theactualson of Trimaar that ends up going down a similar path toHarumi. Benthomaar is both similar and different to Princess Vania from the previous season. Both are children of royalty, although Benthomaar was adopted, both became useful allies to the Ninja, rebel against their kingdoms and their respective rulers, and the current rulers of their kingdoms are horrible people who are also their relatives. For him it was his brother Kalmaar, but for Vania it washer own father King Vangelis.Bentho and Vania also share a moment where they try to convince th

characters.name: Nyad
characters.description: The first Elemental Master of Water and Nya's ancestor, a Merlopian who long ago fought alongside the First Spinjitzu Master and merged with the Endless Sea in order to defeat Wojira. Blue-and-Orange Morality:When we finally meet her in Season 15 it turns out that merging with the sea has caused her to have a very... odd view of the world, to say the least. Heroic Sacrifice: She merged with the Endless Sea to defeat Wojira the first time, despite knowing that she would never be able to reobtain her physical form. Posthumous Character: She's long gone by the events of Season 14.Latersubverted, as she appears in Season 15.

characters.name: The New Ninja
characters.description: A new "vigilante" group of ninjas approved by Mayor Trustable during the year the Ninja were inactive. Adaptational Wimp: Fuchsia Ninja lacks his elemental power of Surprise his counterpart from thatThe LEGO Ninjago Moviehas. Affectionate Parody: The team seems to be one towards thePower Rangers, exhibiting a lot of tropes known to the franchise,Super Sentai, and the Tokusatsu genre. From their heavy use of colored smoke explosions similar to the titular effects of Toku, to their habit of makingSuper Sentai Stances, and their hammy and cheesy dialogue being something straight out ofMighty Morphin' Power Rangers. Blue Is Heroic: More like teal, but the Teal Ninja is the leader of the team. Brainwashed and Crazy:They end up becoming Crystal Zombies around the middle of Season 15.

characters.name: HounddogMcBrag
characters.description: A marshal of the Ninjago City Police, being deployed once the formerly-imprisoned Ninja broke out of jail in order to arrest them. Lawful Stupid: Even when Ninjago City and all of Ninjago are at risk, he's still persistent on his mission to arrest the Ninja. It's not until Lloyd saves him from being crystalized that he finally stops hunting him and the rest of the Ninja down. Super-Persistent Predator: Nearlynothingwill stop him from attempting to arrest those he targets. Even if there's a canyon filled with water, his response? Drive his car off the cliff and into the river after the Ninja.

characters.name: Sally
characters.description: A young girl who's aspiring to become a singer in Ninjago City, though still has a good bit of growing up to do. Ambiguously Bi: In aFreeze-Frame Bonus, the Bisexual flag can be seen on herguitar case, while the guitar itself and also the back of her father's van has the Progress Pride flag. Improvised Weapon: While fighting alongside the Resisance with her parents, she uses her guitar as an improvised weapon, to surprising effectiveness. The Runaway: When Kai, Zane, and Dareth meet her, she's taken her father's van with the intention of becoming a singer/songwriter in Ninjago City.

characters.name: The Elemental Alliance
characters.description: Evil Former Friend: Krux and Acronix were part of the alliance and fought alongside them during the Serpentine War until they turned on the others when they figured their powers made them the most powerful. And of course, Garmadon would later fall to evil. Heroic Lineage: Being Elemental Masters, they're related to the Ninja in different ways.Garmadon and Wu are of course Lloyd's father and uncle respectively.Ray and Maya are Kai and Nya's parents.Benton was Lilly's father and Cole's grandfather.Libber wasJay's biological mother.Hibernus passed his power to Zane. Garmadon and Wu are of course Lloyd's father and uncle respectively. Ray and Maya are Kai and Nya's parents. Benton was Lilly's father and Cole's grandfather.

characters.name: Benton
characters.description: The previous Elemental Master of Earth. The father of Lily and grandfather of Cole. Ambiguously Related: According toTommy Kalmar, there is more in the relationship between Benton and Brook, the previous master ofNature. Though the context of said relation is unclear. Ambiguous Situation: According to Garmadon, Chen's influence (implied to be hismanipulation skills) is what compelled Benton to turn against the Elemental Alliance. However, in theFlashback, Clouse is seen watching secretly, thus implying, and later confirmed byTommy Andreasonto be the work of Dark Magic, that Clouse also had hand in it. So which of the two is true or not is unknown. Although it's also possible that both are true as well. Brainwashed and Crazy: Benton was brainwashed by Clouse to turn against the alliance and aid the Serpentine, but was freed soon after,horrified by what he'd been made to do. Dishing Out Dirt: He was the previous Master of Earth. This is shown when he makes rocks sprout out from the ground to defeat the Elemental Alliance when he wasbrainwashedagainst them.

characters.name: Dusk
characters.description: The previous Elemental Master of Shadow. Breakout Character: Dusk getslittle focuscompared to Benton, Libber, Hibernus, Ray, and Maya but gets a lot of attention from the fandom to the point where she even gets an official minifigure more than a decade later. Casting a Shadow: She’s the Master of Shadow. This is shown when she blends into shadows to defeat the time-traveling Vermillion by ambushing them. Dark Is Not Evil: She’s wears dark purple and fights against evil.

characters.name: Leo
characters.description: The previous Elemental Master of Form. Informed Ability: He is confirmed to be the Master ofFormbut never shapeshifts onscreen. Light Is Good: His color scheme is primarily yellow and he fights evil serpentine. Out of Focus: The least focused previous elemental master. While Benton,Libber, Hibernus, Ray, and Maya got the spotlight as the ninja's predecessors, the other elemental alliance members got to show off their powers in the show, and the Time Twins got to be theArc Villain's of Season 7, Leo gets the short end of the stick due to not showing his power onscreen and it took a long time forWord of Godto confirm that it wasForm. Shapeshifting:Word of Godconfirms him to be the Master of Form.

characters.name: Libber
characters.description: The previous Elemental Master of Lightning andJay's biological mother. All There in the Manual: Her name is never mentioned in the show, where she's referred to as "Lightning". Gladiator Games: Some time beforeJay's birth, she ended up in the Realm of Madness and was forced to fight in a gladiator pit, but used her Lightning Powers to short-circuit the security system and escape.She left the necklace she was forced to wear with Jay when she gave him away. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: She has blonde hair and fights the Serpentine and Hands of Time to protect the people of Ninjago. Hero of Another Story:Dragons Risingreveals that Libber partook in a gladiator pit in the Realm of Madness, and left enough of an impression that the Pit-Mastergenuinely fearsElemental Masters of Lightning as a result.

characters.name: Hibernus
characters.description: The previous Elemental Master of Ice. Zane's predecessor who gave him hisice powers. Blue Is Heroic: He wears a dark blue robe and is a heroic Elemental master. Dark Is Not Evil: His color scheme is dark and has a heroic demeanor. An Ice Person: He was the previous Master of Ice. This is confirmed when he tries to blast ice at Krux in aFlashback. Light Is Good: Has white hair, white gloves, and white coloring on his clothes and fights for good.

characters.name: Levi
characters.description: The previous Elemental Master of Gravity. Gravity Master: He was the previous Mater of Gravity. This is confirmed when he was floating around to combat the Anacondrai in aFlashback Light Is Good: He wears light orange and gold armor and fights for good. Swallowed Whole: He was swallowed up by the Anacondrai Serpent. Next time we see him,he is somehow just fine outside of said serpent. Unexplained Recovery: It is never explained explained how he escaped the Anacondrai Serpent after the latterswallowed him whole.

characters.name: Ash
characters.description: Elemental Master of Smoke. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: With Cinder taking Ash's place as the Elemental Master of Smoke in theDragons Risingseries, there is no word of whatever happened to Ash ever since. Evil Laugh:More mischievous than evilduring his fight with Kai. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: Is quite smug and shifty, but aids the heroes with the fight against Chen and unlike Chamille, there's no aforemention of him going evil. The Quiet One: While he has been heard grunting while fighting and laughing at others, he only saysoneword out of all of his appearances ("Smoke!"), and it's extremely difficult to hear due to the background music and the other Elemental Masters calling out the names of their elementsas they summon their Elemental Dragons.

characters.name: Bolobo
characters.description: Elemental Master of Nature. Ambiguous Situation: InDragons Rising, an elemental master named Zant-Tanz has an elemental power of Plants that is similar to Bolobo's elemental power of Nature. It's unclear if the two power are the same or different. Badass in Distress: Was stated to have been one of the Elemental Masters who got captured by the Sons of Garmadon sometime after they took over Ninjago City. Earthy Barefoot Character: Is the Elemental Master of Nature and has no shoes. Green Thumb: His elemental powers allow him to grow and control vines.

characters.name: Chamille
characters.description: Elemental Master of Form. The Bus Came Back: Returns in "Amber Spiral" after being absent since Season 4. She also reappears in Season two of "Dragons Rising", as a part of the Tournament of.Sources. Jerkass: Definitely qualifies. She may have gone bad after the Sons of Garmadon took over Ninjago City. Out of Focus: While none of the masters get a lot of focus, she is an unusual example as her powers get more focus after Skylor copies them.Played straight come Season 9 as she's one of the few Elemental Masters who didn't joinLa Résistance. Played straight come Season 9 as she's one of the few Elemental Masters who didn't joinLa Résistance.

characters.name: Gravis
characters.description: The Elemental Master of Gravity Gravity Master: His element allows him to move things like telekinesis.

characters.name: Griffin Turner
characters.description: The Elemental Master of Speed. Ambiguous Situation: He and Neuro are captured offscreen, and it's unknown who among them was captured first, leaving their overall placement in the tournamentnoteeither sixth or seventh, below Chen, Lloyd, Skylor, Kai, and Jayunknown. Cool Shades: Wears these at all times. Expy: OfThe FlashfromDC Comics. Nice Guy: He's helpful towards the Ninja and when Chen accused Lloyd of cheating in the rollerblade challenge, he was the first to defend Lloyd.

characters.name: Jacob Pevsner
characters.description: The Elemental Master of Sound. Afro Asskicker: Wields an Afro and is aHandicapped Badass. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Hasn't appeared since the Season 4 finale. And unlike Chamille, who had a canon explanation as to why she wasn't in Season 9 and reappears in "Amber Spiral", Jacob has no explanation and isn't even mentioned at all afterward. By the events of Dragons Rising he is no longer the Elemental of Sound, with the Merlopia Teelk being the new Elemental Master of Sound. Handicapped Badass: He appears to be blind and relies on his ability with sound to create echolocation to fight. Make Some Noise: His element is sound.

characters.name: Karlof
characters.description: The descendant of the Elemental Master of Metal. Originating from Metalonia, Karlof is a brutish, arrogant man, yet a surprisingly skilled engineer. He joined Master Chen's Tournament of Elements because he thought it would be entertaining. The Big Guy: Befitting aMaster of MetalandHusky Russkie, tend to be the powerhouse for whoever he fights with. The Bus Came Back:After a long absence he returns for Season 7, held captive by the Time Twins. Extra-ore-dinary: Use his elemental power to turn his skin to metal. Fire-Forged Friends: Originally starts off as a rival to the Ninja (particularly Kai); by the end of the Season, he's become a good friend, and is overjoyed when they meet again later on.

characters.name: Neuro
characters.description: Descendant of the Elemental Master of Mind. Ambiguous Situation: He and Griffin Turner are captured offscreen, and it's unknown who among them was captured first, leaving their overall placement in the tournamentnoteeither sixth or seventh, below Chen, Lloyd, Skylor, Kai, and Jayunknown. Chronic Backstabbing Disorder: He helped the Ninja during Cole and Jay's fight, but then turned against them in the next episode so that he wouldn't be ostracized like they were since they were a team. He goes back to their side when they warn everybody else about Chen. I Fight for the Strongest Side!: He teamed up with Chamille during the Thunderblade challenge in "Ninja Roll" because he wanted to fight for the winning side. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: Despite his selfish actions, he is on the side of good and is the first Elemental Masters to side with the Ninja when Lloyd allows him to read his mind and shows Chen's real plan.

characters.name: Paleman
characters.description: Also goes by Mr. Pale. He is the Elemental Master of Light. Like Toxikita, he originally came fromUltra Agents, where he was called Invizable. Adaptation Name Change: He was called "Invizable" inUltra Agents, but became Paleman, also known as Mr. Pale, forNinjago. Adaptational Heroism: InUltra Agents, he was one of the super-villains. Here when told the truth about Master Chen, not only did he join in Lloyd's defense, but he was the first to say he will drop out of the tournament if Lloyd gets eliminated. The Bus Came Back: He is one of the few original masters to return in "Dragons Rising". Friendship Denial: He seems to extend an olive branch by asking the Ninja if he can sit with them at lunch, which Jay rudely denies, which given the circumstances may've been a bad call given how many enemies they already had in the tournament.

characters.name: Shade
characters.description: The Elemental Master of Shadow Animal Motifs: Wears a wolf necklace and considering his disinterest in joining up with the Elemental Masters against Master Chen, makes him a lone wolf. Ascended Extra: He was one of the background Elemental Masters in the first four episodes of the fourth season, but got a bigger role in the fifth episode and onward. Casting a Shadow: His element. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Like Ash, he doesn't return inDragons Rising, with the title of Elemental Master of Shadow now belonging to his daughter Obscuria, and it's never stated what happened to Shade himself.

characters.name: Skylor
characters.description: The Elemental Master of Amberand the daughter of Master Chen. All Your Powers Combined: Being the Elemental Master of Amber, she is capable of copying the powers of all the other Elemental Masters and even combining them. Assimilation Backfire: Tommy Anderson claims if she tried to copy theFirst Spinjitzu Master'spowers, she would explode. Becoming the Mask: Was originally supposed to gain Kai's trust, but ended up coming to love him and the Ninja for real. The Call Put Me on Hold: She wanted to join Kai and Nya in fighting the Time Twins, but Nya told her to stay behind. So she did.

characters.name: Tox
characters.description: She is the Elemental Master of Poison. Like Paleman, she originally came fromUltra Agents. Adaptational Heroism: She was a villain inUltra Agents, but here she, while starting out as an enemy to the ninja, was never truly evil and eventually joins them. Breath Weapon: She can breath a toxic cloud if she wants. Costume Evolution: InMasters of Spinjitzu, she used a variation of her original Ultra Agents design (albeit with a head based off of her armored variant from the Winter 2015 wave).Dragons Risinggives her a brand new design, with a green sleeveless jacket over a purple skull shirt, and switches her ponytail out for a mohawk. Delinquent Hair: Has a green, unkempt ponytail in Seasons 4 & 9 and her revamped appearance inDragons Risinghas her sporting a green mohawk.

characters.name: Neido
characters.description: The elemental master of Imagination introduced inLEGO Universe.

characters.name: Samukai
characters.description: Back from the Dead: He is briefly resurrected in "Day of the Departed", acting as one of Sensei Yang's underlings and being sent to fight Jay. He is killed again by the end of the special. Big Bad Wannabe: He really wants to act like the biggest threat around in the world of Ninjago, but he's ultimately no match for Garmadon at all and gets tricked by the latter into getting himself killed as part of Garmadon's plans to control the Golden Weapons. The Cameo: He appears as a costume in the first episode of Skybound "Infamous". Connected All Along: It's implied by some dialogue that he and Pythor met at some point or the latter was aware of his existence. Cool Helmet: In the mini-movies, he was shown wearing Garmadon's helmet. It appears to be the crown of the King of the Underworld, as Garmadon takes it from him when he beats him.

characters.name: Nuckal and Kruncha
characters.description: A duo of dull-witted Skullkins who served under Samukai as the Lightning and Earth Skeleton Generals respectively. Following Samukai's demise, Kruncha, who was previously second-in-command, became the new King of the Underworld. Eventually the two skeletons would leave the Underworld together, looking to adapt to life in Ninjago. Adaptation Dye-Job: Kruncha has a red loincloth in the show but gray in the sets. Art Evolution: Their models get a redesign for their appearance inDragons Rising. Bumbling Henchmen Duo: A pair of comical henchmen contrasting their more serious superiors, Samukai and Garmadon. Butt-Monkey: Suffer all forms ofAmusing Injuriesand humiliation in all their appearances.

characters.name: Master Chen
characters.description: Garmadon's old master who organizes a tournament for the descendants of the elemental masters. He convinces the Ninja to participate as he knows the whereabouts of the supposedly deceased Zane. Abusive Parent: He's a terrible father to Skylor, showing no real concern for her well-being, and treating her as nothing more than a pawn for his plans. All Your Powers Combined: Via the Staff of Elements, he is capable of absorbing all the elements for his own usage, with the only main elements he doesn't have being Time, Water, and Wind. However, he only uses some of these on screen, those beingIce,Smoke,Nature, andMetal. Arch-Enemy: Becomes this to Kai, due to him being the main antagonist of the fourth season with Kai as one of the focus characters. Things get more personal between the two as Chen just so happens to also be the father of Skylor, Kai'sLove Interest. He is also a very personal enemy of Garmadon, with Chen having been his mentor and having encouraged Garmadon's darker impulses, particularly with the letter to Misako, whichChen revealed was actually from Wu, driving a wedge between the two brothers that they never quite reconciled until Garmadon'sHeroic Sacrifice. Archnemesis Dad: For Skylor, once shedefects. Chen even goes as far as using her to turn himself and his army into Anacondrai.

characters.name: Clouse
characters.description: Arch-Enemy: To Garmadon. Both he and Garmadon were Chen's disciples, and Clouse clearly resents Garmadon, taking any opportunity to taunt him about his mistakes. Asshole Victim: His appearance in Skybound amounts to this as he's reduced to being a ghost and subsequently gets tricked and sealed by Nadakhan. It gets undone by the end of the season however. Be Careful What You Wish For:He becomes the first to fall victim to Nadakhan'sJackass Genietendencies. First, he wishes for his spellbook back. It was burnt, so immediately after he gets it, it bursts into flames. Then he wishes to be human again, which hurts. Then he wishes for the pain to go away, which Nadakhan twists into sucking him into the Teapot of Tyrahn. The djinn even says this to him verbatim. Big Bad: Of theDark Island Trilogygraphic novels. Dragged Off to Hell: He was last seen being sent to the Underworld and left at the mercy of the Skulkin.

characters.name: Eyezor
characters.description: Back from the Dead: Was temporarily resurrected in "Day of the Departed" in his Anacondrai form, but returned to the Departed Realm alongside Chen and Zugu upon being defeated by Kai and Nya. Bad Boss: He is pretty mean to Chop and Kapow, though admittedly they were talking bad about him first. Elite Mook: Leads the other mooks and shares the third-in-command position alongside Zugu. Punny Name: His name sounds like "Eyesore," and he has one damaged eye.

characters.name: Zugu
characters.description: Another former "general" of the Anacondrai Cultists, and slave-master in Chen's Noodle Factory. All There in the Manual: Additional materials reveal he used to be a sumo wrestler before Chen recruited him. He also suggested ways of boosting the army's morale, only for Chen to shoot down all of his ideas. Back from the Dead: Was temporarily resurrected in "Day of the Departed" in his Anacondrai form, but returned to the Departed Realm alongside Chen and Eyezor upon being defeated by Kai and Nya. Benevolent Boss: Additional materials reveal he suggested ways of boosting the army's morale, showing he cares for them. To the workers enslaved in Chen's noodle Factory? Not so much. The Big Guy: He's the most physically imposing member of the army.

characters.name: Chope and Kapau
characters.description: A pair of guards with dreams of greatness. Ascended Extra: They get more screen time than any other mooks in Chen's army. Be Careful What You Wish For: They wanted to be more important in Chen's army. Unfortunately, Chen is aBad Bossand then they end up like the rest of his army. Those Two Guys: They're best friends and are always seen together.

characters.name: The Mechanic
characters.description: Ambiguous Situation: It's unclear if the Mechanic was born without a left arm or if he lost his left arm forunknown reasons. Arm Cannon: His robo-arm usually has a large flamethrower nozzle in place of a hand, and it's very much capable of throwing flames. Ascended Extra: In the original series' run he was just a recurring villain, but after theSoft Reboot, he becomes a major antagonist in Season 12 and ends up a member of the Council of the Crystal King in Season 15. Back for the Finale: Returns in Season 15,Crystalizedas part of the Council of the Crystal King. Big Bad Wannabe: Despite being a recurring antagonist who continuously causes trouble in Ninjago, the problems he causes are justtypical Tuesdaysin comparison to all kinds of destruction the main villains (such as Chen,Harumi, Aspheera, and Unagami) cause. Subverted starting in Season 12 when he joins Unagami to free him into the real world and in Season 15 when he joins the Crystal King's council. Even Cole comments that the Mechanic's threat level increased after Season 12.

characters.name: Morro, the Master of Wind
characters.description: The leader of the army. A former student of Sensei Wu who was banished to the Cursed Realm. He gets free when Garmadon sacrifices himself and possesses Lloyd during "Winds of Change", spending most of the season in his body. He reappears inDragons Rising, becoming the caretaker/guardian of the Spectral Lands (a land made from the combination of both the Departed and Spectral realms). Arch-Enemy: One of Wu’s and Lloyd’s most personal foes. Arc Villain: While he's technically justThe Heavyto the Preeminent, Morro is still the leader of the Ghost Army and the primary enemy of the Ninja throughout the season as he schemes to release her. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: He's a very skilled fighter and has complete mastery over his elemental powers, although it alongside his desire to be the Green Ninja ended up giving him a rather large ego. To say he didn't take finding out that he wasn't the Green Ninja very well is an understatement.Morro:You think you're better than me!? NO ONE IS BETTER THAN ME!

characters.name: Wrayth
characters.description: The first ghost that Morro summons. He turns a normal motorcycle into his huge personal cycle and uses a chain in combat. Back for the Finale: After getting killed in his debuting episode, he's later resurrected by Morro in the two-part season finale to help guard the Realm Crystal. Back from the Dead: As stated above. Badass Biker: Good for him that Morro summoned him at a biker bar since it allowed him to quickly find a ride. Chain Pain: Bears the title of Chain Master and wields one with a staff grip and ghost blade.

characters.name: Soul Archer
characters.description: A ghost armed with a cursed bow, able to turn whatever it hits into ghosts. Having made a bet with Ronin before being sent to the Cursed Realm, he now seeks payment. Early-Bird Cameo: It's heavily implied thatthe giant handthat appears in the final level ofLEGO Ninjago: Shadow of Ronin(whichwas originally meantto be canon to the show) belongs to him, due to Ronin expressing fear at its sight. Evil Counterpart: To Zane: they both rely on ranged weaponry, generally act as the calmer and tactical of their group, and both have histories with Ronin; Ronin owes Soul Archer a debt, and likewise, Ronin was the one who brought Zane to Chen's island. This may have been a result of Morro's attempt to emulate Lloyd, the true Green Ninja. Family-Friendly Firearms: His arrows don't kill people, they just transform whatever or whoever they hit into ghosts. Rhymes on a Dime: "Run, run, run away! My arrow will find you anyway!"

characters.name: Ghoultar
characters.description: Ghoultar was one of the Ghost Warriors banished to the Cursed Realm and is potentially among some of its oldest prisoners, considering his clothes are worn away and his flesh had decayed enough to reveal the skull on his face. Big Eater: Many of the ghosts are this, but Ghoultar is a stand-out example. He once ate enough toslow downthe Ghost Warrior's ship, to Morro's frustration and confusion.Morro:How are you slowing us down? You're aghost!Ghoultar:Ghoultar likes Puffy Potstickers. The Brute:Dumb Musclehe may be, his skill with his scyth makes him a formiddable member of the Ghost Army. Dumb Muscle: Easily the least intelligent of the named ghosts. Evil Counterpart: To Cole: They both wield scythes, are the strongest members of their group, and haveBig Eatertendencies. This may have been intentional as a result of Morro's attempts to emulate Lloyd, the true Green Ninja.

characters.name: Bansha
characters.description: Evil Counterpart: To Kai: They both wield blades, have red as part of their color scheme, and generally act more hot-tempered than the rest. This may be a result of Morro's attempt to emulate Lloyd, the true Green Ninja. Master Swordsman: Called the Blade Master and wields swords. Meaningful Name: "Bansha" sounds like "banshee", a female spirit in Irish mythology with a terrible scream. Super-Scream: She can emit a sonic scream, even with her mask on.

characters.name: The Preeminent
characters.description: The Preeminent (also called the Queen of the Cursed) is an eldritch horror who is the embodiment and thus the ruler of the Cursed Realm. Accidental Resurrection:The Season 11 episode "The Kaiju Protocol" has Wu and P.I.X.A.L. accidentally bringing back the Preeminent, who was killed by Nya in Season 5, from the Departed Realm during their search for the Never-Realm. Fortunately, they manage to defend Ninjago City from her rampage and send her back. Dimension Lord: Of the Cursed Realm, thus her title 'The Queen of the Cursed'. According toGarmadon, sheisthe Cursed Realm. Destroying her will destroy the realm as well. Eldritch Abomination: Even more so of one than the Overlord - she's literally the Cursed Realm. Genius Loci: A living, sentient dimension.

characters.name: Ghost Dragons
characters.description: All There in the Manual:Doc Wyattstates that they were once regular dragons who originally cursed and banished to the Cursed Realm by the Oni. Ambiguous Situation: In the set "70738 Final Flight of Destiny's Bounty" appears a ghost dragon who has limbs (not just counting the wings). Whether this is supposed to be another random dragon or a non-canon ghost version of Morro's Elemental Dragon of Wind is unclear. Dragons Are Demonic: Ghost dragons who do the bidding of an evil sentient realm. Non-Standard Character Design: The Ghost Dragon in "70738 Final Flight of Destiny's Bounty" has limbs while the other Ghost Dragons don't, thus giving itthe appearance of a wyvern. Our Dragons Are Different: Compared to the other dragons in the show, they generally are smaller and lack limbs apart from wings.

characters.name: Nadakhan
characters.description: Arch-Enemy: To Jay, the Blue Ninja. Arc Villain: Of Season 6. He sets off to claim the Realm Crystal and reunite his crew. Likewise, heplans to marry Nya so he can grant himself unlimited wishes, recreate Djinnjago and resurrect his deceased lover, Delara. Beat It by Compulsion: One of Nadakhan's weaknesses is that he must grant every wish he hears, so long as the person wishing still has at least one wish left. BFS: The Djin blade also known as the Sword of Souls, is anAncestral Weaponthat has passed down along a line of kings of Djinjago. It has andoddly shaped bladesimilar to the Elemental Blades and sticks out of a skull attached to a hilt, that has two axe blades acting as a guard. If that wasn't enough true to it's name it has the ability to take someone's soul. Even Bad Men Love Their Mamas: Despite being anArc Villain, he genuinely seemed to love his father.

characters.name: Clancee
characters.description: AHypnobrai/Venomarihybrid Serpentine belonging to no tribe in particular and a member of Nadakhan's crew, serving as the least evil member of the crew. All of the Other Reindeer: Implied. Like Pythor before him, Clancee apparently had trouble fitting in with his fellow Serpentine due to being a hybrid and decided to live a life of piracy. The Bus Came Back: Returns in the could-be canon novelThe Splinter In The Blind Man's Eye. Chekhov's Gunman: In a sense. Clancee offhandedly mentions that he is the only one out of the crew to have never wished for anything from Nadakhan, which the djinn eventually takes advantage of to help deal with the remaining ninja. Disproportionate Retribution:He finds himself on the receiving end of this, when gets banished to another dimension for simply mouthing off to Nadakhan.

characters.name: Doubloon
characters.description: A former thief who talked constantly who somehow learned the art of Spinjitzu. He was discovered by Nadakhan when he tried stealing loot fromMisfortune's Keep. However, he was caught in the middle of the act, and upon seeing his skills Nadakhan made his face a fusion of two masks, so he can only look happy or sad, costing him his voice. Ambiguously Human: He has two faces that look like Kabuki masks, and never speaks. I Know Kung Fu: Turns out he can do Spinjitzu. It's never explained where he learned it from. Misplaced Retribution:Nadakhanbanishes him to an unknown realm alongside Monkey Wretch, simply because he was in the same room as Clancee when the latter bad-mouthed Nadakhan. Motor Mouth: Was once this before Nadakhan got his hands on him.

characters.name: Dogshank
characters.description: The largest member of Nadakhan's Sky Pirate crew. The Ace: Her strength, speed, endurance, and skills granted by Nadakhan made her the best at her school (at least according to the skeleton narrating her backstory). Heel–Face Turn:When Nadakhan banishes Clancee, Doubloon, and Monkey Wrench, she decides to defect to the Ninja side with Flintlocke. Sadly she doesn't do it a second time in the Dark Island trilogy and ends up in jail for her troubles. Huge Guy, Tiny Girl: Inverted with Flintlocke. Flintlocke is the same size as most other characters in the show, while Dogshank is a bigfig. Lady Looks Like a Dude: She's no different from male bigfigs from other Lego themes, but she is a female.

characters.name: Flintlocke
characters.description: Nadakhan's second-in-command Accidental Aiming Skills: Lloyd's first wish made Flintlocke lose his proficient marksmanship. Prior to this, despite his claim that henevermisses a shot, Flintlocke tried to shootColebut made a single aiming mistake, which caused the Realm Crystal to be shattered to pieces. Accidental Murder:Flintlocke successfully shot Nadakhan with a single dart containing the Tiger Widow venom to slow him down but accidentally killed Nya with a stray splash of it within the Djinn's proximity. The Dragon: Nadakhan's first mate.At least until the Season 6 finale, where he joins the Ninja to defeat Nadakhan.He later becomes Clouse's dragon, and this time there's noHeel–Face Turn. Guns Akimbo: His favored weapons are a pair of flintlocks.

characters.name: Monkey Wretch
characters.description: Monkey Wretch is a regular human transformed into a monkey who would become a mechanic of the Sky Pirates. Fusion Dance: A forced one between the human named Monkey Wretch and an actual monkey, courtesy of Nadakhan. Misplaced Retribution:Nadakhanbanishes him to an unknown realm alongside Doubloon, simply because he was in the same room as Clancee when the latter bad-mouthed Nadakhan. Punny Name: His name is a play on the tool named "Monkey Wrench", which also doubles as a meaningful name because he is both the Sky Pirates' mechanic but also was transformed into a monkey after Nadakhan fused him with one. Was Once a Man: Thewebsitesays he was the ship's mechanic, before he made the mistake of wishing tohis bossto have more hands and be faster.

characters.name: Squiffy and Bucko
characters.description: Two modern-day citizens of Ninjago who joined Nadakhan's crew. Meaningful Rename: Their names originally weren't Sqiffy and Bucko, but Nadakhan changed them after having them join the crew. The Quisling: They are modern Ninjago citizens who volunteered to join Nadakhan's crew.

characters.name: Delara
characters.description: A deceased sky pirate, and Nadakhan's lover. Back from the Dead: After Nadakhan is granted infinity wishes he uses one to bring Delara back into Nya's body. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: In her short screen time she's shown to not be any better than Nadakhan, but she legitimately loves him. Identical Stranger: She looksexactlylike Nya, which is why Nadakhan wants to use the latter as a vessel for her resurrection. The Lost Lenore: Nadakhan is bereaved with sorrow after learning she passed away while he was imprisoned. The only reason he's pining after Nya is because she looks like her,and once he becomes king he uses his power to bring her back to life.

characters.name: Time Twins In General
characters.description: The Time Twins, a.k.a the Hands of Time, are the powerless Elemental Masters of Time. Their goal is to travel back in time to rule Ninjago. The Ace: They're pretty great fighters. It took all of the previous Elemental Masters and four blades made from Chronosteel to remove their powers to stop them. Arch-Enemy: Two of Wu’s most personal enemies, as well as Kai’s and Nya’s. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Both are extremely arrogant fighters and time manipulators, something noted in the story. They themselves call their enemies out on this trope on occasion. Badass Cape: They wear green capes and are incredible fighters.

characters.name: Acronix
characters.description: Annoying Younger Sibling: He at times irritates his brother Krux, who really hates modern technology, with his love for it, and is much younger than him. (Originally 3 minutes, but now biologically four decades younger.) Born in the Wrong Century: He was born decades ago, but later grew to love modern-day life, much to Krux's annoyance. (Un)fortunately for him, he was able to travel to the future, (the present) and gets to experience modern technology and even suggested goingfurther into the futureinstead of the past when he and his brother had to time travel in "Lost in Time". It's heavilyimpliedthat, despite saying otherwise and unlike his brother, he much rather continue living in the future rather than useTime Travelto bring Ninjago back to the way it was before technology. Buffy Speak: Unless it's a Borg-Watch or a Borg-Pad, Acronix doesn't know the proper names for modern gadgets.Justifiedsince he's been outside time for 40 years. Compressed Hair: He has rather long hair to the point of having to tie most back in a low ponytail and leave some on his shoulders, but somehow manages to fit all his hair in his outfit's hood. Easily Impressed: When it comes to modern technology, it doesn't matter how mundane it is. He even thinks a commercial is cool.Justifiedsince he is from four decades from the past, before Ninjago became advanced, and thus never seen anything like modern technological gadgets and advancements up until now. Krux is extremely annoyed by this.

characters.name: Krux/Dr. Sander Saunders
characters.description: Aloof Older Brother: He can be like this to Acronix at times, especially when Acronix is involved with technology and is much older than him (Originally 3 minutes, but now four decades older). Antiquated Linguistics: The way he talks is rather old-fashioned, and he calls Acronix "Brother" instead of his name and vice versa. Badass Bookworm: He is intelligent and can put up a fight despite his age. Berserk Button: Modern life and technology. Hereallyhates how modern life and technology "ruined" Ninjago and is planning to go back in time so Ninjago will remain low-tech. Unfortunately for him, Acronix developed anextremelove for what he hates, which is the main cause of their bickering. Big, Stupid Doodoo-Head: Krux fires one at Kai in "A Time of Traitors". Quite thelame comebackKrux:Well, aren't you clever. Such a smart little ninja.

characters.name: Mr. E
characters.description: Asshole Victim:Garmadon kills him for failing to capture Lloyd. Although given how much destruction Mr. E has caused and how he beat Zane to near-death, only his teammates mourn him. Back from the Dead: After 5 Seasons ofbeing dead, he reappears in Season 15,Crystallized, in arebuiltform known as Mister F. Breakout Villain: One of the most memorable villains of Season 8, due to his cool design, creepy demeanor and mysterious past. This is most likely the reason behind his return in Season 15 as a major antagonist. Co-Dragons: One of The Quiet One's three generals, alongside Ultra Violet and Killow. Cold-Blooded Torture:Finds himself in the receiving end of it courtesy of a VERY pissed offEmperor Garmadon, this also results in his death after getting torn apart (quite literally).

characters.name: Ultra Violet
characters.description: Ax-Crazy: Ultra Violet loves creating mayhem and violence. Beware the Silly Ones: She might beAx-Crazy, but she's alsoThe Quiet One's smartest general and, ironically, theOnly Sane Womanofherteam. The Bus Came Back: She reappears in theGarmadoncomic series, and also returns for Season 15 as a part of the resistance. Co-Dragons: of The Quiet One alongside Mr. E and Killow. Do Not Call Me "Paul": Ultra Violet does not appreciate being called "Ms. Violet" by some lower-ranking henchmen.

characters.name: Killow
characters.description: Back for the Finale: Returns in Season 15 as a part of the resistance. The Big Guy: His nickname is "The Big Man", and it shows.
